description: Features 7 + 3 — Share card AND Android/desktop install prompt (A2HS). Both are outward-facing PWA pieces with no Dexie/schema impact, so they ship together. (7) Generate an on-brand progress share card to PNG via the Canvas 2D API (offscreen, SSR-guarded, emoji-free drawn text, brand emerald, system font) and share via the Web Share API with files, with a PNG download fallback and a friendly degrade when neither works; pure stat-line formatting is unit-tested. (3) beforeinstallprompt handling in src/lib/pwa.ts (SSR-safe, feature-detected) + a dismissible 'Pasang Heula' button on Profile that coexists with the existing iOS install hint without both nagging. Depends on FEAT-001 for the shared foundation; must NOT break the SW/notifications subsystem or the iOS hint.
steps: Read FIRST: the absolute context.json and this file, plus src/lib/pwa.ts and src/features/settings/ReminderSettings.tsx (existing iOS install hint — must keep working).

SHARE pure helper — create src/lib/share.ts (NO React, NO @/db): `formatShareStats(input: { currentStreak: number; totalHours: number; totalFasts: number; methodLabel: string }): string[]` returning emoji-free Indonesian stat lines (streak, total jam, total puasa, metode). Keep it pure + framework-free so it is unit-testable.
src/lib/__tests__/share.test.ts: assert formatShareStats produces the expected emoji-free lines for representative inputs (zero stats and populated stats) and contains no emoji characters.

src/lib/copy.ts: add a `share` namespace (card title/heading text drawn on the canvas and the UI action labels 'Bagikan progres' / 'Unduh gambar' / friendly fallback message) and an `install` namespace ('Pasang Heula' button + dismiss label + short blurb) — all emoji-free Gojek voice.

src/types/index.ts + src/components/ui/Icon.tsx: add IconKey `share_social -> IoShareSocialOutline` (reuse existing `share`, `install`, `download` keys where present; do not duplicate). Keep `satisfies`.

Create src/features/share/ShareCard.tsx ('use client', SSR-guarded — guard typeof window/document/navigator and canvas support): on action, draw a PORTRAIT 1080x1920 offscreen <canvas> (create via document.createElement('canvas')) with brand emerald #0e9f6e background accents, a system/web-safe font, and the emoji-free lines from formatShareStats + simple shapes (NO external assets, NO charting lib); export PNG via canvas.toBlob. Share with `navigator.canShare && navigator.canShare({ files: [pngFile] })` then `navigator.share({ files: [pngFile], title, text })`. FALLBACK when file-share is unsupported: an 'Unduh gambar' link from URL.createObjectURL(blob) (revoke after). When neither share nor download is available, show the friendly copy.share fallback message. Never throw on the server.

Add a 'Bagikan progres' entry on src/features/stats/StatsOverview.tsx (and/or Profile) that mounts/triggers ShareCard, feeding it the live totals/streaks (reuse @/lib/stats over the live session query) and the current method label.

INSTALL (A2HS) — extend src/lib/pwa.ts with SSR-safe, feature-detected beforeinstallprompt support WITHOUT changing the existing isStandalone/isIOS/shouldShowIOSInstallHint logic. Add a tiny typed interface for the BeforeInstallPromptEvent and any pure helper worth testing (if a new pure helper is added, extend src/lib/__tests__/pwa.test.ts to assert its SSR-safe default).

Create src/features/pwa/InstallPrompt.tsx ('use client'): listen for the window 'beforeinstallprompt' event (preventDefault + stash the event in state), render a dismissible 'Pasang Heula' button only when the event has fired AND !isStandalone(); on click call event.prompt() and await event.userChoice, then hide; hide after dismiss or accept. Because iOS Safari never fires beforeinstallprompt, this button is Android/desktop-only and will NOT appear on iOS — so it cannot nag alongside the iOS hint.

Mount <InstallPrompt/> on src/app/profile/page.tsx ONLY (the iOS hint stays in ReminderSettings on the same screen; the two target disjoint platforms and never both show). Do NOT modify src/app/sw.ts or src/lib/notifications.ts; do NOT alter the existing iOS hint logic in ReminderSettings.
acceptance_criteria: src/lib/share.ts formatShareStats is pure, emoji-free, and covered by passing tests.

ShareCard renders a portrait PNG via Canvas (SSR-guarded, emoji-free drawn text, brand emerald), shares via navigator.share with files when supported, falls back to an 'Unduh gambar' download, and degrades to friendly copy when neither is available — never throwing on the server.

beforeinstallprompt is handled SSR-safely; the 'Pasang Heula' button appears only on supporting (Android/desktop) browsers when not standalone, calls prompt()+userChoice, and hides after; the existing iOS install hint still works and the two never both nag.
src/app/sw.ts and src/lib/notifications.ts are unchanged; the four layout files are unchanged vs HEAD.
`npx vitest run src/lib/__tests__/share.test.ts src/lib/__tests__/pwa.test.ts` passes; `npx tsc --noEmit` clean; `npm run build` succeeds; no-emoji scan green.
findings: Implemented Features 7 (share card) + 3 (A2HS install prompt). NEW: src/lib/share.ts (pure, framework-free formatShareStats -> 4 emoji-free Indonesian stat lines, hours rounded) + src/lib/__tests__/share.test.ts (4 tests incl. emoji scan). src/features/share/ShareCard.tsx ('use client', SSR-guarded: window/document/navigator/canvas access only inside the click handler; draws a portrait 1080x1920 offscreen canvas via document.createElement, brand emerald #0e9f6e + accent shapes, system font, emoji-free text from formatShareStats; exports via canvas.toBlob; shares via navigator.canShare({files})+navigator.share, falls back to an object-URL PNG download (revoked after), degrades to copy.share.fallback; AbortError on user-cancel is swallowed). src/features/pwa/InstallPrompt.tsx ('use client'): listens for beforeinstallprompt (preventDefault + stash in state) and appinstalled, renders a dismissible 'Pasang Heula' Card only when the event fired AND !isStandalone(); iOS never fires the event so it cannot nag with the iOS hint. MODIFIED: src/lib/pwa.ts added SSR-safe BeforeInstallPromptEvent interface + canPromptInstall() (existing isStandalone/isIOS/shouldShowIOSInstallHint UNCHANGED); src/lib/__tests__/pwa.test.ts +1 SSR-default test. src/lib/copy.ts added emoji-free copy.share + copy.install namespaces. src/types/index.ts + src/components/ui/Icon.tsx added IconKey share_social -> IoShareSocialOutline (satisfies kept). src/features/stats/StatsOverview.tsx mounts ShareCard with live totals/streaks + resolved method label. src/app/profile/page.tsx mounts <InstallPrompt/>. UNCHANGED (verified empty diff vs HEAD): src/app/sw.ts, src/lib/notifications.ts, the four layout files, and the ReminderSettings iOS hint logic. Verification: npx tsc --noEmit clean; targeted + full vitest green (262 tests, up from 253: +4 share, +1 pwa, +4 no-emoji for new files); npm run build succeeds + SW generated; eslint 0 errors (2 pre-existing warnings in untouched files).
